site.name: PrintxPDF
site.tagline: Print only what matters. Fix any PDF.
site.description: Turn any web page into a clean printout or PDF, then do everything else to a PDF — merge, sign, compress, OCR, protect, convert — with free tools that run on your own computer. No account, nothing to install.
site.footerNote: Independent project. Not affiliated with any other print or PDF service.
